靳兰玦不确定自己的净化术在这样的身体情况下能用几次，使用范围会不会有影响。

她问林柯：“你有可以快速提升我体力的东西吗？可以快速补充能量的。”

林柯不确定，她翻了翻自己的背包：

“我有压缩饼干，还有……唔，生理盐水有用吗？哦还有一盒牛奶。”

靳兰玦全部吃掉了。

林柯和徐阳的表情生动演绎了靳兰玦的直播间弹幕。

【传下去，大师作法之前要吃三大碗饭！】

【哈哈哈哈你们够了！】

【我真是服了，赶紧跑啊！还过去看啥啊！】

弹幕吵起来了。

靳兰玦已经根据自己脑海中的诡物感知地图，带着另外两人绕向山的另一边。

既然想抱大腿，也要表示出自己的一点用处。

这是很现实的，在这样生死难料的环境中，救人大概会搭上自己的性命，大家素不相识的，肯定是自保为主。

哪怕林柯刚才那么热情要救她，也是因为看重她或许有可以对付诡物的能力。

三人很快就靠近了刚才男人尖叫的地方。

整个地面像被挖掘机刨过一遍，满地泥土松软，枯树歪七扭八，纵横交错的树枝完全堵死了可能通过的道路。

最高的一棵枯树顶端，架着一个男人。

扭曲的枯枝从四面八方蔓延而来，钻进男人的耳朵，眼睛，嘴巴……

它们像穿衣服一样，顾涌着往男人的身体里钻，密集的树根下面，缠绕捆绑着两个人。

他们看到同伴的惨状，已经吓得失禁，空气里一股浓郁的尿骚味。

感受到新来的人，扭动的枯树纷纷调转方向，朝向靳兰玦三人。

脚下土地翻涌，数不清的枯树就像扭曲拉长的诡影，乌泱泱地扑了上来！

徐阳立刻双手合十，掌心之间腾出一团暖黄的亮光，立刻驱散了扑向他的枯树诡影。

林柯清喝一声，手中长棍一甩，只是单手就扫断了面前的两棵枯树。

靳兰玦站在两人身后，心中止不住打鼓。

Jin Lanjue was not sure how many times his purification technique could be used in such a physical condition, and whether the range of use would be affected.

She asked Lin Ke: "Do you have anything that can quickly increase my physical strength? Something that can quickly replenish energy."

Lin Ke was not sure, so she rummaged through her backpack:

"I have compressed biscuits, and...well, does saline help? Oh, and a carton of milk."

Jin Lanjue ate them all.

The expressions of Lin Ke and Xu Yang vividly interpreted Jin Lanjue's live broadcast room barrage.

[Pass it down, the master has to eat three big bowls of rice before doing this!】

[Hahahaha, that’s enough for you!】

[I’m really convinced, run away!What else are you going to see?】

The barrage started making noise.

Jin Lanjue had already led the other two people around to the other side of the mountain based on the map of strange objects in his mind.

Since you want to hug your thigh, you must also show some of your usefulness.

This is very realistic. In such an environment where life and death are unpredictable, saving others may cost your own life. If you are a stranger, you must first protect yourself.

Even if Lin Ke was so enthusiastic about saving her just now, it was because he thought she might have the ability to deal with strange things.

The three of them quickly approached the place where the man screamed just now.

The entire ground seemed to have been plowed by an excavator. The soil on the ground was soft, dead trees were twisted, and crisscrossing branches completely blocked the possible roads.

On the top of the tallest dead tree was a man.

Twisted dead branches spread from all directions, getting into the man's ears, eyes, mouth...

Like wearing clothes, they rushed into the man's body, and two people were entangled and tied under the dense tree roots.

When they saw the miserable state of their companions, they were so frightened that they lost control. There was a strong smell of urine in the air.

Sensing the new arrival, the twisting dead trees turned towards Jin Lanjue and the others.

The ground beneath our feet surged, and countless dead trees rushed up like twisted and elongated shadows!

Xu Yang immediately clasped his hands together, and a warm yellow light appeared between his palms, which immediately dispersed the strange shadows of the dead trees that rushed toward him.

Lin Keqing shouted, swung the long stick in his hand, and swept down the two dead trees in front of him with just one hand.

Jin Lanjue stood behind the two of them, his heart beating uncontrollably.
